author: Brian Rudman
title: Firebirds prepare for playoffs seeking second consecutive title - NewsBreak
text:
By Brian Rudman ,
1 hours ago
ALBANY, NY ( NEWS10 ) — After winning the Arena Crown in 2025, the championship of the Arena Football One league, the Albany Firebirds enter the 2026 playoffs seeking a second consecutive title. The squad’s championship defense will begin on Saturday when they face the Minnesota Monsters in the semifinals.
The Firebirds are the No. 2 seed in this year’s playoffs after an injury-riddled, 9-3 regular season. Albany used back-to-back bye weeks – one to close the regular season and one in the opening round of the playoffs – to get some key pieces back in the lineup. Firebirds head coach and general manager Damon Ware said at practice on Wednesday this is the healthiest the team has been in about eight weeks.
With an adversity-filled regular season behind them, the Firebirds prepare for their semifinal matchup with the Monsters – a team Albany beat by 27 points in the lone meeting of the season.
The Firebirds are excited to be back in the playoffs with a chance to repeat as Arena Crown Champions.
“How many people can say they compete for a championship every year?” said Ware. “That’s the Albany way; we’ve set the standard here for a long time. We just gotta get through one opponent, and we can be back in the championship game. When you start the season, you want to just knock off each goal, each at a time. Being a first or second seed was one of them; now it’s win a home game here in the semifinals and go to the finals.”
The Firebirds and Monsters kick off from MVP Arena on Saturday at 4 p.m.
